dict.string: Monorail actions, layouts, app pairs and templates

#!/bin/zsh # Lists Monorail actions and what's saved, filtered by the query. dir="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Monorail" port=$(cat "$dir/api-port" 2>/dev/null) token=$(cat "$dir/api-token" 2>/dev/null) if [[ -z "$port" ]]; then echo '{"items":[{"title":"Turn on Monorail’s local API","subtitle":"Monorail ▸ Settings ▸ Automation ▸ Local API","valid":false}]}' exit 0 fi get() { curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $token" "http://127.0.0.1:$port/$1"; } /usr/bin/python3 - "$1" "$(get actions)" "$(get layouts)" "$(get pairs)" "$(get templates)" <<'PY' import json, sys, urllib.parse query = sys.argv[1].lower() actions, layouts, pairs, templates = (json.loads(a or "[]") for a in sys.argv[2:6]) items = [{"title": a["title"], "subtitle": a["name"], "arg": "monorail://" + a["name"]} for a in actions] for kind, names, path in (("Layout", layouts, "layout"), ("App pair", pairs, "pair"), ("Template", templates, "template")): items += [{"title": n, "subtitle": kind, "arg": f"monorail://{path}/" + urllib.parse.quote(n)} for n in names] items = [i for i in items if all(t in (i["title"] + " " + i["subtitle"]).lower() for t in query.split())] print(json.dumps({"items": items[:40]})) PY
Type mr and part of an action, layout, app pair or template. Needs Monorail's local API (Settings → Automation).
